parameters.value: export default async function ({ page, context }) {   const sleep = ms =>     new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));    let cookies = context.cookies || [];    if (typeof cookies === "string") {     cookies = JSON.parse(cookies);   }    if (!Array.isArray(cookies)) {     throw new Error("Invalid Gleeph cookies.");   }    await page.setUserAgent(     "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122 Safari/537.36"   );    await page.setRequestInterception(true);    page.on("request", request => {     if (       ["image", "font", "media"].includes(request.resourceType())     ) {       request.abort();     } else {       request.continue();     }   });    if (cookies.length) {     await page.setCookie(...cookies);   }    await page.goto(context.url, {     waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",     timeout: 90000   });    await page.waitForSelector(     "div[class*='bookHorizontal_bookHorizontalContainer']",     { timeout: 60000 }   );    const uniqueBooks = new Map();    let unchanged = 0;   let rounds = 0;    while (unchanged < 8 && rounds < 400) {     rounds++;      const extracted = await page.evaluate(() => {       const clean = value =>         String(value || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();        function status(card) {         const colors = Array.from(           card.querySelectorAll(             "div[class*='booksRelationsContainerTag']"           )         ).map(tag =>           (tag.style.backgroundColor || "")             .replace(/\s+/g, "")             .toLowerCase()         );          const owned = colors.includes("rgb(60,164,255)");         const read = colors.includes("rgb(92,228,92)");          if (owned && read) {           return "Possédé et Lu";         }          if (colors.includes("rgb(213,154,237)")) {           return "Possédé et Je lis";         }          if (owned) {           return "Possédé et Non lu";         }          if (read) {           return "Non possédé mais Lu";         }          if (colors.includes("rgb(252,169,92)")) {           return "Liste de souhait";         }          return "Non classé";       }        return Array.from(         document.querySelectorAll(           "div[class*='bookHorizontal_bookHorizontalContainer']"         )       )         .map(card => {           const link = card.querySelector("a[href*='/book/']");            if (!link) return null;            return {             url: new URL(               link.getAttribute("href"),               location.origin             ).href.split("?")[0],              titre: clean(               card.querySelector("h2")?.textContent             ),              auteur: clean(               card.querySelector("h3")?.textContent             ),              genre: clean(               card.querySelector(                 "p[class*='categoryObject']"               )?.textContent             ),              statut: status(card)           };         })         .filter(book => book && (book.titre || book.auteur));     });      const before = uniqueBooks.size;      for (const book of extracted) {       uniqueBooks.set(book.url, book);     }      unchanged =       uniqueBooks.size === before ? unchanged + 1 : 0;      await page.evaluate(() => {       const button = Array.from(         document.querySelectorAll("button")       ).find(b =>         !b.disabled &&         (b.textContent || "").toLowerCase().includes("voir plus")       );        if (button) {         button.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });         button.click();       }        window.scrollBy(0, 3000);     });      await sleep(1800);   }    if (!uniqueBooks.size) {     throw new Error(       "No Gleeph books found. Check the URL and session."     );   }    if (rounds >= 400 && unchanged < 8) {     throw new Error("Gleeph pagination did not finish.");   }    const enriched = await page.evaluate(async entries => {     function readMetadata(doc, book) {       const clean = value =>         String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();        function isbn(value) {         const match = String(value ?? "").match(           /(?:^|[^\d])(97[89]\d{10}|\d{9}[\dXx])(?=$|[^\d])/         );          return match ? match[1].toUpperCase() : "";       }        function year(value) {         const match = clean(value).match(/\b([12]\d{3})\b/);         return match ? Number(match[1]) : null;       }        function number(value) {         const text = clean(value)           .replace(/[\s\u00a0\u202f]/g, "")           .replace(",", ".");          const match = text.match(/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?/);         return match ? Number(match[0]) : null;       }        function names(value) {         const values = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];          return [...new Set(           values             .map(v => clean(               v && typeof v === "object"                 ? v.name || v.labelFr                 : v             ))             .filter(Boolean)         )];       }        const targetIsbn = isbn(book.isbn) || isbn(book.url);        const candidates = Array.from(         doc.querySelectorAll(           "table[class*='resumeDetailsPanelTable']"         )       ).map(table =>         Array.from(table.querySelectorAll("tr")).map(row =>           Array.from(row.querySelectorAll("td")).map(cell =>             clean(cell.textContent)           )         )       );        const rows =         candidates.find(r =>           targetIsbn && isbn(r[2]?.[1]) === targetIsbn         ) ||         candidates.find(r =>           r.length >= 3 &&           (!targetIsbn || !isbn(r[2]?.[1]))         ) ||         [];        const expectedIsbn =         targetIsbn || isbn(rows[2]?.[1]);        const schemaBooks = [];        function collect(value) {         if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;          if (Array.isArray(value)) {           value.forEach(collect);           return;         }          const types = [].concat(value["@type"] || []);          if (           types.some(type => /(?:^|\/)Book$/.test(type))         ) {           schemaBooks.push(value);         }          if (value["@graph"]) {           collect(value["@graph"]);         }          if (value.mainEntity) {           collect(value.mainEntity);         }       }        for (const script of doc.querySelectorAll(         "script[type='application/ld+json']"       )) {         try {           collect(JSON.parse(script.textContent));         } catch {}       }        const schema =         schemaBooks.find(v =>           expectedIsbn && isbn(v.isbn) === expectedIsbn         ) ||         (           !expectedIsbn && schemaBooks.length === 1             ? schemaBooks[0]             : null         );        /* Read Next.js data if the Details tab is absent. */        let flightText = "";        for (const script of doc.querySelectorAll("script")) {         const pattern =           /self\.__next_f\.push\((\[[\s\S]*?\])\)/g;          let match;          while (           (match = pattern.exec(script.textContent || ""))         ) {           try {             const chunk = JSON.parse(match[1]);              if (               chunk[0] === 1 &&               typeof chunk[1] === "string"             ) {               flightText += chunk[1];             }           } catch {}         }       }        const records = [];        const recordIsbn =         expectedIsbn || isbn(schema?.isbn);        function findEdition(value) {         if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;          if (Array.isArray(value)) {           value.forEach(findEdition);           return;         }          if (           recordIsbn &&           [value.isbn, value.ean, value.id, value.glid]             .some(v => isbn(v) === recordIsbn) &&           (             "price" in value ||             "pages" in value ||             "publisher" in value           )         ) {           records.push(value);         }          Object.values(value).forEach(findEdition);       }        for (const line of flightText.split("\n")) {         const colon = line.indexOf(":");          if (colon < 0) continue;          try {           findEdition(             JSON.parse(line.slice(colon + 1))           );         } catch {}       }        const edition =         records.find(v =>           v.publisher && v.publicationYear         ) ||         records[0] ||         {};        if (         !schema &&         !rows.length &&         !records.length       ) {         throw new Error(           "No matching book metadata: " + book.url         );       }        const pages = [         number(rows[1]?.[1]),         number(schema?.numberOfPages),         number(edition.pages)       ].find(v =>         Number.isInteger(v) && v > 0       ) || 0;        const price =         number(rows[2]?.[0]) ??         number(edition.price) ??         0;        const publishers = names(         rows[0]?.[0] ||         schema?.publisher ||         edition.publisher       );        let genres = names(schema?.genre);        if (!genres.length) {         genres = names(edition.glcatObj?.labelFr);       }        if (!genres.length) {         genres = names(book.genre);       }        return {         ...book,          isbn: expectedIsbn || isbn(schema?.isbn),         nb_pages: pages,         Prix: Number(price.toFixed(2)),          editeur: publishers.join(" / "),          annee_sortie:           year(rows[1]?.[0]) ||           year(edition.publicationYear) ||           year(schema?.datePublished) ||           year(schema?.copyrightYear),          genre: genres.length > 1           ? JSON.stringify(genres)           : genres[0] || ""       };     }      async function fetchBook(book) {       let lastError;        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {         const controller = new AbortController();          const timer = setTimeout(           () => controller.abort(),           30000         );          try {           const response = await fetch(book.url, {             credentials: "include",             signal: controller.signal           });            if (!response.ok) {             throw new Error(               "HTTP " + response.status             );           }            const html = await response.text();            const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(             html,             "text/html"           );            return readMetadata(doc, book);         } catch (error) {           lastError = error;         } finally {           clearTimeout(timer);         }       }        throw new Error(         "Gleeph details unavailable: " +         book.url +         " - " +         lastError.message       );     }      const results = new Array(entries.length);     let cursor = 0;      async function worker() {       while (cursor < entries.length) {         const index = cursor++;         results[index] = await fetchBook(entries[index]);       }     }      await Promise.all(       Array.from(         { length: Math.min(4, entries.length) },         () => worker()       )     );      return results;   }, Array.from(uniqueBooks.values()));    return {     data: {       statut_session: "valide",       mode_extraction: "gleeph_details_jsonld",       data: enriched,       livres: enriched.length     },     type: "application/json"   }; }
